description: Agriauto Industries Limited manufactures components for cars, motorcycles and agricultural tractors, and sells into both original-equipment and aftermarket channels. Incorporated in 1981 and part of the House of Habib group, it makes shock absorbers and struts under technical assistance agreements with KYB Corporation of Japan and Gabriel Ride Control of the USA, along with pressed sheet-metal parts and tractor steering components.
headOffice: 5th Floor, House of Habib, 3 JCHS, Block 7/8, Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi, Pakistan
